content: When crossing both parameters, we can observe that the gender distribution is not constant throughout roles. Women represent 29.47% of the speakers within the Anchor category, even less than among the Punctual speakers. Their percentage of speech is also smaller. When calculating the average speech time uttered by a female Anchor, we obtain a value of 15.9 min against 25.2 min for a male Anchor, which suggests that even within the Anchor category men tend to speak more. This confirms the existence of gender disparities within French media. It corroborates with the analysis of the CSA BIBREF1, which shows that women were less present during high-audience hours. Our study shows that they are also less present in important roles. These results legitimate our initial questioning on the impact of gender balance on ASR performance trained on broadcast recordings.
